The migration is scheduled for wave 2 in 2027Q4 as part of the data center exit.

SYS-146.text: This monitoring system scores low on both business value (2.15 of 5) and technical health (1.4 of 5), with its platform already past end of support in 2024, triggering an Eliminate decision and Retire strategy. Retiring the system will save NOK 561k annually against a one-off cost of NOK 66k, paying back in 0.12 years. The retirement is scheduled for 2027Q2 as a quick win with minimal dependencies, supporting the data center exit.

SYS-147.text: Microsoft Intune scores high on both business value (4 of 5) and technical health (4.55 of 5), well above investment thresholds. The TIME category is Invest and the 6R strategy is Retain: keep the system as-is and continue investing in it. Run costs remain stable at NOK 1.75M per year with no savings expected, but the decision is justified by the system's strategic importance and strong technical foundation rather than cost reduction.

SYS-148.text: PaperCut utskrift scores low on business value (2.25 of 5) but adequate technical health (3.25 of 5), placing it in Tolerate. The Rehost strategy applies because this small, simply integrated on-premises system requires minimal effort to move. Rehosting will save NOK 24k annually with a one-off cost of NOK 162k, paying back in 6.8 years, and supports data center exit in wave 1 during 2027Q4.

SYS-149.text: Citrix Virtual Apps 7.15 scores high on business value (4.1 of 5) but critically low on technical health (1.35 of 5), primarily due to platform end-of-support expiring in 2022 and poor scalability. The Migrate category with Repurchase strategy replaces it with a SaaS alternative such as Azure Monitor or Veeam Cloud. Although run costs will increase by NOK 245k annually and one-off migration costs are NOK 812k, the decision is justified by eliminating end-of-life risk and supporting data center exit in wave 3 (2028Q3).

SYS-150.text: Palo Alto Panorama scores high on both business value (4.2 of 5) and technical health (4.65 of 5), placing it in the Invest category. The Replatform strategy will move this critical firewall management system to a managed platform, reducing annual run costs from NOK 1.29M to NOK 1.07M (saving NOK 223k yearly) despite a one-off replatform cost of NOK 864k. The migration is scheduled for wave 2 in 2027Q4 as part of the data center exit.
